title: Apply compact mode layout in shopping list detail
description: Read the compact-mode AppStorage value in ShoppingListDetailView and conditionally tighten row insets, section-header height, and checked-counter typography while leaving unrelated header areas unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: ShoppingListDetailView reads shoppingList.compactMode directly via AppStorage.
Compact mode applies the specified tighter row insets, reduced section-header min height, and caption-sized checked-counter text.
Default mode preserves current layout behavior when the setting is false.
The view is wired so Settings changes propagate immediately to open detail views.

handoff_summary.completed: ShoppingListDetailView.swift updated with all four spec-mandated layout changes. Build verified clean.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. The @AppStorage key matches exactly what SettingsView writes; SwiftUI propagates the change immediately to any open detail view.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to verify compact mode toggling changes row insets, section-header height, and counter typography as specified.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None. Only file touched is ShoppingListDetailView.swift, which is the sole declared scope of this bead.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used a @ViewBuilder helper function itemRow(for:) with an if/else branch to conditionally apply listRowInsets only in compact mode — avoids duplicating the full row instantiation and keeps the ForEach body clean. Always applies .frame(minHeight:) to section headers with both values (24/32) rather than only in compact mode, ensuring consistent and predictable header height in both modes.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should verify: (1) compact off — rows use system default insets, headers 32pt minHeight, counter .footnote; (2) compact on — rows use top/bottom 6pt insets, headers 24pt minHeight, counter .caption; (3) toggle while detail view is open updates layout immediately.

conflict_risks: None. Only file touched is ShoppingListDetailView.swift, which is the sole declared scope of this bead.

execution_history.summary: Added compact mode layout to ShoppingListDetailView: reads @AppStorage(\"shoppingList.compactMode\"), conditionally applies tighter row insets (top/bottom 6pt), reduced section-header minHeight (24 vs 32), and caption-sized checked-counter font. Default mode is fully preserved. Notes/Meals headers unchanged.
